create_function_query: create a function that sends a vision-language model request to the HuggingFace router API and returns the JSON response
build_api_request: build a POST request to the HuggingFace chat completions endpoint with an authorization header and a message payload
test_query_vlm: test the query function with a vision-language model payload containing text and image_url content
summarize_response: summarize the response from the HuggingFace API by extracting the assistant message from choices
review_headers_config: review the headers configuration that sets the Bearer token from the HF_TOKEN environment variable
